result.summary: Strengthens the `private_broadcast` fuzz target by tracking transaction addition timestamps and peer confirmation times. It computes which transactions satisfy staleness timing conditions and asserts that `PrivateBroadcast::GetStale()` returns exactly the expected set rather than an arbitrary subset.
result.problem: The fuzz harness previously verified that transactions returned by `GetStale()` were valid candidates, but did not test completeness or timing rules. An implementation bug such as premature loop termination would omit stale transactions without failing tests, leading `ReattemptPrivateBroadcast()` to silently abandon transactions that need to be rebroadcast.
evidence: Description notes that mutant 3752 on MutantHub (changing `continue` to `break` in `GetStale()`) passes all current tests without detection.
Description notes that `ReattemptPrivateBroadcast()` only retries what `GetStale()` returns, so omitted stale transactions are never retried.
PR discussion reference: partly came up during review in PR #35129.
result.changed_since_previous: The implementation approach is unchanged from the previous version.
result.card: Strengthens the private broadcast fuzz target by tracking transaction addition and peer confirmation timestamps to assert that GetStale() returns the exact expected set of stale transactions. The harness previously only checked that returned transactions were valid candidates, permitting mutations such as changing continue to break in loop iteration to pass tests undetected. Because ReattemptPrivateBroadcast() only retries transactions returned by GetStale(), any omitted stale transaction is silently abandoned.

risk.why: A flaw would only cause false positive test assertions or inaccurate test coverage in the private broadcast fuzz target.
